q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'His behaviour worried us.'
o: We were worried about his behaviour.
We were worried with his behaviour.
e: His behaviour worried us বাক্যের passive করলে object us হয়ে যায় subject We, আর verb past tense বলে was/were + past participle বসে। Worried-এর পরে কারণ বোঝাতে about বসানো প্রচলিত, তাই We were worried about his behaviour। অর্থ: তার আচরণ নিয়ে আমরা উদ্বিগ্ন ছিলাম। Worried with কোনো প্রচলিত রূপ নয়।

q: The passive form of 'I don't like people telling me what to do'.
o: I don't like being told what to do.
I don't like people being told what to do.
I don't like people are told what to do.
People are not liked by me to telling me what to do.
e: Like, hate, mind, remember-এর পরে 'object + V-ing' থাকলে passive-এ 'being + V3' বসে। এখানে মূল subject I-ই অপরিবর্তিত থাকে, তাই আলাদা করে 'people' রাখার দরকার নেই; সাধারণভাবে people থাকলে passive-এ তা বাদ যায়। ফলে সঠিক রূপ 'I don't like being told what to do.'। অর্থ: আমাকে কী করতে হবে তা বলে দেওয়া আমি পছন্দ করি না। 'people being told' দিলে অর্থ বদলে অন্য মানুষদের বলা বোঝায়।

q: The correct passive form of the sentence 'Take care of your health.'
o: Let your health taken care
Let your health be taken care of
Let your health taken care of
Health is taken care by you
e: Imperative বাক্যের passive-এ Let + object + be + V3 কাঠামো বসে। take care of একটি phrasal verb, তাই of শেষে থেকে যায়: Let your health be taken care of। অর্থ: নিজের স্বাস্থ্যের যত্ন নাও। প্রথম ও তৃতীয় অপশনে be নেই, আর চতুর্থটি imperative-এর গঠন বদলে ফেলেছে।

q: When did you buy the book? The correct passive voice of the sentence is..
o: When the book was bought by you?
When was the book bought by you?
When the book were bought by you?
When were the book bought by you?
e: Simple past tense-এর Wh-question-এর passive গঠন হলো Wh-word + was/were + object + past participle + by + agent। এখানে object 'the book' singular, তাই 'was' বসে: When was the book bought by you? প্রশ্নবাচক বাক্য বলে auxiliary verb 'was' কে subject-এর আগে আনতে হয়, যা ক ও গ অপশনে করা হয়নি। ঘ অপশনে inversion ঠিক থাকলেও singular 'book' এর সঙ্গে 'were' ব্যবহার ভুল। গ অপশনে inversion নেই এবং verb-ও ভুল। একই নিয়মে 'Who wrote the book?' এর passive হয় 'By whom was the book written?'

q: " I know him" এর passive কি?
o: He is known to me
He is being known to me
He was known to me
He is known by me
e: "I know him"-এর passive form হলো "He is known to me"। Active বাক্যটি present indefinite, তাই passive-এ "is + past participle (known)" বসে। Object "him" passive-এ subject হয়ে "He" হয়, আর subject "I" হয় "me"। know, please, satisfy, surprise, interest ইত্যাদি কিছু verb-এর পর passive-এ by-এর বদলে নির্দিষ্ট preposition বসে, তাই know-এর ক্ষেত্রে "known to" ব্যবহৃত হয়। "is being known" present continuous আর "was known" past tense, তাই tense মেলে না। একইভাবে "I am pleased with his work", "The news surprised me" থেকে "I was surprised at the news" হয়।

q: The construction workers built a new shopping mall in the city center within six months. Which of the following correctly transforms the active sentence into a passive voice?
o: A new shopping mall was building in the city center within six months.
A new shopping mall was built in the city center within six months.
A new shopping mall was being built in the city center within six months.
A new shopping mall was building by the construction workers in the city center within six months.
e: Past Indefinite tense-এর active বাক্যকে passive করতে object subject হয়ে বসে, তারপর was বা were + past participle। যেহেতু object (a new shopping mall) singular, auxiliary হয় was, আর built হলো past participle। তাই A new shopping mall was built in the city center within six months সঠিক। চাইলে শেষে by the construction workers বসানো যায়। was building হলো ভুল গঠন, আর was being built Past Continuous-এর passive।
